stage_scope: Coarse inclusive/exclusive outer-function intervals across warmup+all3 sweeps; every non-root boundary is called at most once per BMM; nested exclusive totals avoid double counting. Pure kernel interval excludes official caller checksum/refcount work, which remains included in each whole benchmark row.
limits: Per-function clocks, different per-case process/cache context, instrumentation/compiler layout and startup make stage/whole deltas diagnostic only; never project these microtimes to official gain.
unknown_boundaries: RowStream scope exclusive combines computation, output and cleanup after excluding outer Amap/packB. Cross words combines preparation, packet computation and repairs; Cross scope exclusive contains output materialization after words plus cleanup. Direct scopes combine complete compute/output. Underflow scans remain root exclusive. Missing/unexecuted boundaries are UNKNOWN, never zero-cost claims.
artifacts: No ELF/object exported; generated source/patch-equivalent originals, commands, link responses, hashes, logs and checksum rows only.
